sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Filtering is a little quicker on every page, and noticeably less wasteful on big ones: the check behind the (N) WARNING ⚠️ / (N) ERROR ❌ summary buttons used to look for those icons in every cell of every row each time you typed, on every kind of page — even though only a release's track listing can have them. On a 4174-row events page that was 87 654 fruitless searches taking 64 ms per keystroke. It now looks once per row instead of once per cell, and on a page with no such icons it stops looking at all after the first pass. The buttons themselves count exactly what they counted before, including while a filter hides the rows they refer to.
